items.title: 14.15.2 Measures to control air pollution (air pollution rokne ke qadam) (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 14.15.2, printed pages 318-319.

items: Vehicle emission standard (gariyon ke dhuen ki limit): is standard ko laagu karne ka maqsad motor gariyon se pollution kam karna hai. Saaf fuels, jaise compressed natural gas (CNG) aur liquid petroleum gas (LPG), ko promote karna (barhawa dena), aur fuel quality par sakht regulation (kitab mein 'sticker regulation' chhapa hai, ghaliban 'stricter').

Industrial emission control: factories se emission kam karna, aur factories ko cleaner production (saaf tareeqe se cheezen banana) ki techniques aur pollution control technologies apnane ke liye encourage karna.

Public awareness campaigns (logon ko aagah karna): logon ko air pollution ke sources aur effects (asar), aur apna hissa kam karne ke tareeqe batana; saath hi public transport, carpooling (mil kar ek gari mein safar) aur bina engine ke transport, jaise cycling aur paidal chalna, ko promote karna.

Urban planning aur green infrastructure: air quality behtar karne ke liye shehron mein green belts aur parks banana, aur aisi planning karna jo traffic congestion (rash) kam kare aur sustainable (lambe arse tak chalne wale) transport ko promote kare.

Smog control measures: khaas taur par sardiyon mein, jab air quality bohat gir jati hai, smog control karne ke khaas measures (qadam); crop residues (fasal ki baqi bachi cheezen) jalane par pabandi, jo smog ki bari wajah hai; aur hawa se PM kam karne ke liye smog towers aur doosri technologies ka istemal.
Khuli aag par pabandi: ghar aur factories ka koora khuli aag mein jalane par pabandi (ban), kyun ke is se dhool, dhuan aur bohat se air pollutants paida hote hain.
Low-sulphur diesel ka istemal: diesel mein sulphur ki permissible level (ijazat wali had) kam karna.

blocks.text: In regulations aur measures ke zariye Pakistan air quality behtar karna aur public health (logon ki sehat) aur environment par air pollution ke bure effects kam karna chahta hai.

blocks.prompt: Smog control karne ke khaas measures kya hain?
blocks.explanation: Sardiyon par khaas dhyan: fasal ki baqiyat jalane par pabandi; smog towers aur PM kam karne wali doosri technologies; gariyon ke emission standards aur saaf fuels; factories aur bhattiyon ke emission par control; koora khuli aag mein jalane par pabandi.

items: Measures: vehicle emission standards aur saaf fuels (CNG, LPG); industrial emission control; public awareness aur public transport; green belts aur urban planning; smog control (crop residue jalane par pabandi, smog towers); khuli aag par pabandi; low-sulphur diesel.
